posts.author: mytgd
posts.body:
This app is a database management tool for RPG Maker MZ.
When creating a game with RPG Maker, grouping logically related variables makes it easier to identify and call them.
This app allows you to
insert
or
delete
Variables, Switches, CommonEvents, Actors, Classes, Skills, Items, Weapons, Armors, Enemies, Troops, States, Animations, and Tilesets. The changes apply to both CommonEvents and Maps.
* Please back up your project folder or data folder before running this app.
* While I've carefully tested and made this app as bug-free as possible, there may be bugs I haven't discovered. Please let me know if you encounter any.
Thank you.
https://mytgd.itch.io/rpg-maker-dbsplice
